title: The Kid
subtitle: A Picture with a Smile – and a Tear

sections.text:
THIS IS A HOSPITAL. TWO WOMEN AND A MAN COME TO THE DOOR. ONE OF THE 
WOMEN HAS A BABY IN HER ARMS. SHE IS THE BABY’S MOTHER. THE OTHER WOMAN 
UNLOCKS THE DOOR. THEN, SHE OPENS IT.  THE MOTHER COMES OUT OF THE 
HOSPITAL. THE MAN AND THE WOMAN WATCH THE MOTHER WALK AWAY . THEY LIKE 
HER. THEN, THE WOMAN LOCKS THE DOOR.
THE MOTHER IS SAD. SHE IS POOR. SHE IS ALONE. SHE HAS NO FAMILY . SHE DOESN’T 
HA VE A HUSBAND. SHE HAS NO MONEY . SHE HAS NO HOME. SHE DOESN’T KNOW 
WHERE TO GO. HER BABY IS HER CROSS.

SHE GOES TO THE PARK. SHE SITS DOWN ON A BENCH. SHE IS ALONE. SHE THINKS 
ABOUT HERSELF AND HER BABY . 
THE BABY’S FATHER IS IN HIS HOUSE. HE HAS A PICTURE OF THE MOTHER. HE LOOKS 
AT IT. HE THINKS SHE IS BEAUTIFUL.
THE FATHER IS AN ARTIST. HE PAINTS PICTURES. THE MAN SAYS: ‘THIS PICTURE IS 
BEAUTIFUL”. THE ARTIST SAYS: ‘THANK YOU’. THE PICTURE OF THE MOTHER FALLS 
INTO THE FIRE. THE PICTURE STARTS TO BURN. THE ARTIST TURNS AROUND. HE SEES 
THE PICTURE BURNING. HE TAKES IT OUT OF THE FIRE. BUT, THE PICTURE IS BURNED. 
THE MAN THROWS THE PICTURE BACK INTO THE FIRE. THE MAN LIGHTS HIS PIPE. THE 
PICTURE BURNS COMPLETELY .

THIS IS THE HOUSE OF A RICH FAMILY . THEIR CAR IS IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE. THE 
MOTHER WALKS BY THE HOUSE. SHE STOPS BESIDE THE CAR. SHE HAS AN IDEA. SHE 
THINKS: ‘THIS FAMILY IS RICH. THEY CAN TAKE CARE OF MY BABY .’. SHE PRAYS TO 
GOD. SHE OPENS THE CAR DOOR AND GETS IN. SHE PUTS HER BABY ON THE BACK 
SEAT. SHE KISSES THE BABY . SHE GETS OUT OF THE CAR. SHE CLOSES THE DOOR. SHE 
LEA VES QUICKLY . THE BABY IS NOT AFRAID. IT DOESN’T CRY . THE WOMAN LEA VES 
QUICKLY .
TWO MEN CROSS THE STREET. THEY STOP. THEY LOOK AROUND. THEY ARE THIEVES. 
THEY WANT TO STEAL THE CAR. THEY GET INTO THE CAR QUICKLY . THEY DRIVE 
AWAY . THEY DRIVE FAST. THE WOMAN GOES BACK TO THE PARK. SHE SITS ON THE 
BENCH AGAIN. SHE THINKS ABOUT HER BABY . SHE IS SAD.

THE THIEF STOPS THE CAR. THE THIEVES GET OUT OF THE CAR. THE FAT THIEF WANTS 
TO SMOKE A CIGARETTE. THEY SHAKE HANDS. THE BABY CRIES. THE THIEVES HEAR 
THE BABY . THE THIN THIEF SAYS: ‘LOOK IN THE CAR.’. THE FAT THIEF TAKES OUT HIS 
GUN. HE WALKS SLOWLY TO THE CAR. HE OPENS THE DOOR QUICKLY . HE GETS IN THE 
CAR. HE PICKS UP THE BABY . THE THIN THIEF SAYS: ‘NO. THROW THE BABY IN THE 
TRASH CAN.’. THE THIEF PUTS THE BABY ON THE GROUND BESIDE THE TRASH CAN. 
HE LOOKS AROUND. HE GOES TO THE CAR. THE THIEVES GET IN THE CAR. THEY DRIVE 
AWAY QUICKLY . THE WOMAN IS STILL SITTING ON THE PARK BENCH. SHE IS THINKING 
ABOUT HER BABY . SHE STANDS UP. SHE WALKS SLOWLY AWAY .

THIS IS CHARLIE. HE IS WALKING. SOMEONE THROWS TRASH OUT OF A WINDOW. 
CHARLIE CLEANS HIS COAT WITH HIS HAND. CHARLIE HAS A CANE. CHARLIE PUTS 
THE CANE ON HIS ARM. HE IS SMOKING. SOMEONE THROWS TRASH OUT OF A 
WINDOW. THE TRASH FALLS ON CHARLIE. CHARLIE LOOKS UP. HE SHOUTS: “IDIOT”. 
CHARLIE LOOKS IN THE TRASH CAN. CHARLIE TAKES A SMALL BOX OUT OF HIS 
POCKET. HE OPENS THE BOX. HE HAS CIGARS AND CIGARETTES IN THE BOX. HE TAKES  
OUT A CIGARETTE. HE CLOSES THE BOX. HE PUTS THE CIGARETTTE IN HIS MOUTH. HE 
PUTS THE BOX BACK INTO HIS POCKET. HE PUTS HIS CANE ON HIS OTHER ARM. HE 
TAKES OFF HIS GLOVES. THE GLOVES ARE VERY OLD. THERE ARE MANY HOLES IN THE  
GLOVES. CHARLIE TAKES OUT A MATCH. HE LIGHTS HIS CIGARETTE. HE THROWS THE 
GLOVES INTO THE TRASH CAN.
6- CHARLIE HEARS A BABY CRYING. HE TURNS AROUND. HE SEES THE BABY LYING ON 
THE GROUND. HE LOOKS AT AT THE BABY . HE THINKS SOMEONE THREW THE BABY IN 
THE TRASH. CHARLIE PICKS UP THE BABY . A WOMAN WALKS BY . SHE IS PUSHING A 
BABY CAR. CHARLIE SEES THE WOMAN. HE FOLLOWS HER. HE SHOUTS: "WAIT!". 
CHARLIE PUTS THE BABY IN THE BABY CAR. CHARLIE SAYS: "EXCUSE ME. YOU 
DROPPED YOUR BABY ." THE WOMAN IS ANGRY . SHE SHOUTS: "THIS IS NOT MY BABY! 
TAKE YOUR BABY OUT OF MY BABY CAR!" CHARLIE PICKS UP THE WOMAN'S BABY . 
THE WOMAN SHOUTS: "NO. DON'T TAKE MY BABY! TAKE YOUR BABY ." THE WOMAN IS 
VERY ANGRY . CHARLIE PICKS UP THE BABY . HE GOES BACK TO THE TRASH CAN. HE 
PUTS THE BABY BESIDE THE TRASH CAN. BUT HE DOESN'T SEE THE POLICEMAN. THE 
POLICEMAN IS BEHIND HIM. CHARLIE STANDS UP. HE TURNS AROUND. HE SEES THE 
POLICEMAN. HE GOES BACK. HE PICKS UP THE BABY AGAIN. CHARLIE LEA VES WITH 
THE BABY IN HIS ARMS. THE POLICEMAN WATCHES HIM.

CHARLIE SEES AN OLD MAN WITH A CANE AND A BIG BEARD. CHARLIE STOPS AND 
SAYS: ‘HOLD THIS BABY , PLEASE. I WANT TO TIE MY SHOE.’ CHARLIE GIVES THE BABY 
TO THE OLD MAN. HE STARTS TO TIE HIS SHOE. BUT CHARLIE STANDS UP. HE TURNS 
AROUND AND RUNS AWAY . THE OLD MAN SHOUTS: “COME BACK”. CHARLIE HIDES. 
THE OLD MAN LOOKS FOR CHARLIE. HE DOESN’T SEE CHARLIE. BUT HE SEES THE 
BABY CAR. HE PUTS THE BABY IN THE BABY CAR. THEN, HE LEA VES. THE WOMAN 
COMES OUT. SHE SEES CHARLIE’S BABY IN HER BABY CAR. SHE IS VERY ANGRY .

CHARLIE WALKS BY .  THE WOMAN SEES HIM. SHE GRABS HER UMBRELLA. SHE 
RUNS AFTER CHARLIE. THE WOMAN HITS CHARLIE ON THE HEAD WITH HER 
UMBRELLA. CHARLIE FALLS ON THE GROUND.  THE WOMAN GRABS CHARLIE BY HIS 
COAT. SHE HITS HIM ON THE HEAD WITH HER UMBRELLA AGAIN. CHARLIE GETS UP. 
THE WOMAN HITS CHARLIE AGAIN AND AGAIN. SHE PUSHES CHARLIE BACK TO HER 
BABY CAR AND SHOUTS: ‘THIS IS NOT MY BABY . TAKE IT AND GO AWAY’. A 
POLICEMAN COMES. THE WOMAN SAYS TO THE POLICEMAN: “THIS MAN PUT HIS BABY  
IN MY BABY CAR’. CHARLIE PICKS UP THE BABY AND LEA VES.

CHARLIE IS WALKING ON THE SIDEWALK. CHARLIE DROPS HIS CANE. HE SITS DOWN.  
HE PICKS UP HIS CANE. HE THINKS: ‘I CAN PUT THE BABY IN THIS HOLE.’ BUT HE 
THINKS AGAIN: ‘NO. THAT IS A BAD IDEA.’ CHARLIE SAYS: I CAN NOT TAKE CARE OF 
THIS BABY .’ CHARLIE FINDS A NOTE ON THE BABY . THE NOTE SAYS: ‘PLEASE LOVE 
AND TAKE CARE OF THIS ORPHAN CHILD.’ CHARLIE THINKS: ‘I LIKE THIS BABY . I 
WANT TO TAKE CARE OF IT.’ CHARLIE PUTS THE NOTE IN HIS POCKET AND SMILES. 
CHARLIE STANDS UP AND TURNS AROUND. HE TAKES THE BABY HOME. TWO WOMEN 
ARE SITTING ON THE DOORSTEP. CHARLIE SAYS: ‘EXCUSE ME. I WANT TO GO IN.’ ONE 
WOMAN STANDS UP. SHE ASKS: ‘IS THIS YOUR BABY?’  CHARLIE ANSWERS: ‘YES, IT IS 
MY BABY .’ THE WOMAN ASKS: ‘WHAT IS ITS NAME?’ CHARLIE SAYS: ‘WAIT A MINUTE.’ 
CHARLIE GOES IN. THEN, HE COMES BACK OUT AND SAYS: ‘HIS NAME IS JOHN.’ THEN 
HE GOES BACK IN.

CHARLIE OPENS THE DOOR. HE COMES INTO HIS APARTMENT. HE CLEANS HIS 
SHOES ON THE RUG. HE CLOSES THE DOOR WITH HIS FOOT. HE TAKES OFF HIS HAT. HE 
THROWS HIS HAT ON THE BED. HE SITS DOWN ON A CHAIR. HE PUTS THE BABY ON HIS 
LEGS. BUT THE BABY IS WET. CHARLIE STANDS UP. HE GETS A TOWEL. HE PUTS IT ON 
HIS LEGS. THEN HE SITS THE BABY ON THE TOWEL. THE BABY IS CRYING. CHARLIE 
PLAYS WITH THE BABY . BUT THE BABY DOESN’T STOP CRYING. CHARLIE SCRATCHES 
HIS HEAD.

THE MOTHER IS WORRIED ABOUT HER BABY . SHE RUNS BACK TO THE HOUSE OF 
THE RICH FAMILY . SHE WANTS HER BABY BACK. BUT, THE CAR IS NOT IN FRONT OF 
THE HOUSE. SHE IS WORRIED. SHE THINKS: ‘WHERE IS MY BABY?’ SHE BITES HER 
FINGERNAILS. THE DRIVER OF THE CAR COMES DOWN THE STEPS. THE WOMAN ASKS 
HIM: ‘WHERE IS MY BABY?’ THE DRIVER DOESN’T ANSWER. HE DOESN’T 
UNDERSTAND. THE WOMAN RUNS TO THE HOUSE. THE DRIVER LOOKS FOR THE CAR. 
HE SAYS: ‘WHERE IS THE CAR?’ THE WOMAN RINGS THE DOORBELL. A MAN ANSWERS 
THE DOOR. THE WOMAN SAYS: ‘WHERE IS MY BABY’ I PUT MY BABY IN YOUR CAR. 
NOW, THE CAR IS NOT IN FRONT OF THE HOUSE. WHERE IS MY BABY?’ THE MAN 
DOESN’T ANSWER. THE DRIVER COMES BACK. HE SAYS: ‘SOMEONE STOLE THE CAR’. 
THE MOTHER FAINTS.

CHARLIE HAS A CLOTH. HE IS MAKING DIAPERS FOR THE BABY . HE PUTS THE 
DIAPER ON THE CHAIR. THE BABY IS DRINKING MILK FROM A COFFEE POT. HE IS 
HUNGRY . CHARLIE CUTS THE CLOTH WITH SCISSORS. HE IS MAKING DIAPERS FOR THE  
BABY . THE BABY STARTS TO CRY . HE WANTS MORE MILK. HE IS VERY HUNGRY . 
CHARLIE GIVE HIM MORE MILK. THE BABY STOPS CRYING. CHARLIE PLAYS WITH THE 
BABY . CHARLIE. CHARLIE SMILES AND MAKES FACES. THE BABY LOOKS AT CHARLIE. 
HE SMILES AT CHARLIE. HE LIKES CHARLIE. CHARLIE SHAKES THE BABY . BUT 
CHARLIE’S HAND GETS WET. CHARLIE DRIES HIS HAND ON THE BLANKET. CHARLIE 
CUTS A HOLE IN THE CHAIR WITH A PAIR OF SCISSORS. HE MAKES A BATHROOM FOR 
THE BABY . HE KISSES THE BABY’S FOOT.

NOW, IT IS FIVE YEARS LATER. THE POLICEMAN IS WALKING ON THE SIDEWALK. 
JOHN IS SITTING ON THE SIDEWALK.  JOHN IS CLEANING HIS FINGERNAILS. THE 
POLICEMAN WATCHES JOHN. JOHN IS CLEANING HIS FINGERNAILS. THE POLICEMAN 
WATCHES JOHN. THE POLICEMAN SCRATCHES HIS HEAD. JOHN SEES THE POLICEMAN. 
JOHN STANDS UP. HE STRETCHES. HE GOES IN THE HOUSE. CHARLIE LIGHTS THE 
STOVE WITH A MATCH. JOHN OPENS THE DOOR. HE SAYS ‘HI’ TO CHARLIE. HE IS 
SMILING. HE IS HAPPY . CHARLIE SAYS: ‘COME IN’. JOHN COMES IN. CHARLIE TAKES A 
COIN OUT OF HIS POCKET.  HE GIVES THE COIN TO JOHN.

JOHN GETS ON THE TABLE. HE PUTS THE COIN IN THE MACHINE. THEN HE TAKES 
OUT THE COIN AGAIN. HE GETS OFF THE TABLE. HE GOES TO CHARLIE. HE GIVES THE 
COIN BACK TO HIM. CHARLIE PUTS THE COIN IN HIS POCKET. HE SITS DOWN ON THE 
CHAIR. HE CALLS JOHN. HE SAYS: ‘JOHN, SHOW ME YOUR FINGERNAILS. ARE THEY 
CLEAN?’ CHARLIE TAKES OFF JOHN’S HAT. HE LOOKS AT HIS HEARS. CHARLIE TAKES 
OUT HIS HANDKERCHIEF. HE CLEANS JOHN’S NECK. THEN, HE CLEANS JOHN’S NOSE. 
THEN CHARLIE CHECKS JOHN’S HAIR. THEN, HE PUTS JOHN’S HAT ON HIS HEAD.

CHARLIE SAYS: ‘GO DOWN THE STREET. THEN, TURN LEFT.’ JOHN KISSES CHARLIE’S  
EAR AND GOES OUT. CHARLIE PUTS ON HIS HAT AND COAT. THE BOY PICKS UP SOME 
ROCKS. HE PUTS THE ROCKS IN HIS POCKET. CHARLIE PUTS SOME GLASS ON HIS 
BACK. HE IS GOING TO FIX BROKEN WINDOWS. CHARLIE GOES DOWNSTAIRS. JOHN 
GOES TO A CORNER. HE HAS A ROCK IN HIS HAND. HE THROWS THE ROCK. HE BREAKS 
THE WINDOW. HE THROWS ANOTHER ROCK. THEN HE RUNS AWAY . HE RUNS ACROSS 
THE STREET. THEN, HE RUNS AROUND THE CORNER. A FAT, OLD WOMAN COMES OUT 
OF THE HOUSE. CHARLIE COMES BY . THE WOMAN SAYS: ‘CAN YOU FIX MY WINDOW? 
CAN YOU PUT A NEW GLASS IN MY WINDOW?’ CHARLIE SAYS: ‘YES, I CAN’. THE 
WOMAN GOES IN. CHARLIE STARTS TO FIX THE WINDOW.

JOHN GOES TO ANOTHER STREET. HE THROWS ANTOHER ROCK. HE BREAKS 
ANOTHER WINDOW. THEN HE RUNS AWAY AGAIN. HE RUNS ACROSS THE STREET TO 
ANOTHER CORNER. HE TAKES A ROCK OUT OF HIS POCKET. A POLICEMAN COMES. HE 
STANDS BEHIND JOHN. JOHN RAISES HIS ARM TO THROW THE ROCK. BUT, HE SEES THE  
POLICEMAN. HE SMILES AT THE POLICEMAN. HE THROWS THE ROCK ON THE GROUN. 
THEN JOHN POINTS AND SAYS: ‘LOOK THERE’ THE POLICEMAN LOOKS. JOHN RUNS 
AWAY . THE POLICEMAN SEES THE BROKEN WINDOW. HE IS ANGRY .

THEN, HE SEES CHARLIE FIXING THE WINDOW. THE POLICEMAN THINKS: ‘THE BOY 
BREAKS THE WINDOWS AND CHARLIE FIXES THEM.’ CHARLIE DOESN’T SEE THE 
POLICEMAN. THE POLICEMAN WATCHES CHARLIE. CHARLIE TURNS AROUND. HE SEES 
THE POLICEMAN. CHARLIE PUTS THE GLASS ON HIS BACK. THE WOMAN COMES OUT 
OF THE HOUSE. SHE WANTS TO PAY CHARLIE. SHE ASKS: ‘HOW MUCH IS IT?’ CHARLIE 
ANSWERS: ‘ONE DOLLAR.’ THE WOMAN PAYS CHARLIE. THE POLICEMAN WANTS TO 
FIGHT WITH CHARLIE. CHARLIE GIVES BACK THE MONEY AND LEA VES. THE WOMAN 
DOESN’T UNDERSTAND. CHARLIE STARTS TO GO ACROSS THE STREET. JOHN FOLLOWS 
CHARLIE. CHARLIE PUSHES JOHN AWAY WITH HIS FOOT. THE POLICEMAN FOLLOWS 
CHARLIE AND THE BOY CHARLIE AND JOHN RUN AROUND THE CORNER. THE 
POLICEMAN RUNS AFTER THEM.

CHARLIE IS FIXING ANOTHER WINDOW. A WOMAN COMES OUT OF THE HOUSE. SHE 
LOOKS AT THE WINDOW. CHARLIE PUTS HIS ARM AROUND THE WOMAN’S WAIST. THE 
WOMAN SAYS: ‘DON’T PUT YOUR ARM AROUND MY WAIST. I AM MARRIED.’ CHARLIE 
SAYS: ‘EXCUSE ME’. THEN CHARLIE SAYS: ‘DON’T PUT YOUR ARM ON MY SHOULDER. I 
AM MARRIED.’ THEY LAUGH. THEN THE WOMAN’S HUSBAND COMES HOME. HE IS A 
POLICEMAN. HE GOES IN THE HOUSE.

THEN, THE POLICEMAN COMES OUT. HE IS LOOKING FOR HIS WIFE. CHARLIE AND 
HIS WIFE ARE TALKING AND LAUGHING. THE POLICEMAN GOES BACK IN . CHARLIE 
WHISPERS IN THE WOMAN’S EAR. THEY LAUGH. THEY HUSBAND SEES CHARLIE AND 
HIS WIFE. CHARLIE PUTS THE WOMAN’S ARM ON HIS SHOULDERS. THE POLICEMAN 
GRABS CHARLIE’S COAT. HE SHAKES CHARLIE. THEN, THE HUSBAND PUTS HIS HAND 
ON CHARLIE’S THROAT. CHARLIE TURNS AROUND AND SEES THE POLICEMAN. 
CHARLIE RUNS AWAY . THE POLICEMAN RUNS AFTER HIM.

CHARLIE AND JOHN RUN DOWN THE STREET. THE POLICEMAN IS FOLLOWING 
THEM. THE POLICEMAN FALLS DOWN.  THEY RUN BACK UP THE STREET.  THEY RUN 
DOWN THE STREET AGAIN. CHARLIE AND JOHN RUN AROUND THE CORNER. THEY 
HIDE. THE POLICEMAN RUNS BY THEM. BUT HE DOESN’T SEE THEM. THEY RUN INTO 
THEIR HOUSE. FOOD IS COOKING ON THE STOVE. CHARLIE SMELLS THE FOOD. HE IS 
HUNGRY . THEY COME IN. THEY TAKE OFF THEIR COATS AND HATS. THEY PUT THEM ON  
THE BED. THE POLICEMAN COMES BACK LOOKING FOR CHARLIE. THE MAN POINTS 
AND THE POLICEMAN RUNS AWAY . CHARLIE PUTS THE FOOD ON THE PLATES. THEY 
WANT TO EAT.

NOW, JOHN’S MOTHER IS AN ACTRESS. SHE IS A STAR. SHE IS RICH. MANY PEOPLE 
GIVE HER FLOWERS. A MAN COMES IN.  HE SHAKES HER HAND. HE SAYS: ‘YOU ARE A 
GOOD ACTRESS’ THE MAN STARTS TO CRY . HE TAKES OUT HIS HANDKERCHIEF. HE 
DRIES HIS EYES. HE SAYS: ‘READ THE NEWSPAPERS. THEY WROTE ABOUT YOU. THEY 
SAY YOU ARE A GOOD ACTRESS.’ HE KISSES HER HAND. A BOY BRINGS MORE 
FLOWERS. THE MAN SAYS: ‘THE FLOWERS ARE BEAUTIFUL.’ THE MAN CRIES AGAIN. 
THEN, HE LEA VES. THE BOY SAYS TO THE ACTRESS: ‘ PLEASE WRITE YOUR NAME 
HERE’. SHE WRITES HER NAME. THE BOY STARTS TO LEA VE. BUT THE WOMAN SAYS: 
‘COME BACK. I WANT TO GIVE YOU SOMETHING.’ SHE TAKES A COIN OUT OF HER 
POCKET. SHE GIVES IT TO THE BOY . THE BOY IS VERY HAPPY . HE SMILES. HE TAKES 
THE COIN. THEN, HE LEA VES. THE WOMAN PUTS ON HER HAT. SHE LOOKS AT HERSELF 
IN THE MIRROR. A FAT WOMAN BRINGS SOME TOYS. SHE GIVES THE TOYS TO THE 
ACTRESS.

CHARLIE AND JOHN EAT ALL THE FOOD IN THEIR PLATES. CHARLIE IS DRINKING 
WATER. JOHN ASKS CHARLIE TO PUT WATER IN HIS PLATE. CHARLIE PUTS WATER IN 
JOHN’S PLATE. JOHN WASHES HIS FINGERS AND HIS MOUTH. HE DRIES HIS MOUTH 
WITH HIS SHIRT. CHARLIE WASHES HIS FINGERS AND HIS MOUTH. HE DRIES HIS 
MOUTH WITH HIS SHIRT. CHARLIE WASHES HIS FINGERS AND HIS MOUTH. HE DRIES 
HIS MOUTH WITH HIS SHIRT. CHARLIE WASHES HIS FINGERS AND HIS MOUTH. HE 
DRIES HIS FINGERS ON THE TABLECLOTH. HE DRIES HIS MOUTH ON THE TABLECLOTH.  
THE ACTRESS GOES TO CHARLIE’S STREET. SHE WANTS TO GIVE TOYS TO THE POOR 
CHILDREN. THE CHILDREN ARE VERY HAPPY . A WOMAN COMES. SHE HAS A BABY IN 
HER ARMS. THE ACTRESS WANTS TO HOLD THE BABY .  THE WOMAN GIVES THE BABY 
TO THE ACTRESS. SHE SITS DOWN ON THE SIDEWALK. SHE LIKES THE BABY . SHE 
SMILES AT IT. NOW, SHE REMEMBERS HER BABY . SHE IS SAD.

JOHN OPENS THE DOOR AND COMES OUT. HE SITS DOWN ON THE DOOR STEP. HE 
LOOKS AT THE ACTRESS. HE DOESN’T KNOW THAT SHE IS HIS MOTHER. THE ACTRESS 
TURNS AROUND. SHE LOOKS AT JOHN. SHE SMILES AT HIM. AND JOHN SMILES AT HER. 
THE ACTRESS DOESN’T KNOW THAT JOHN IS HER SON. THE ACTRESS SAYS: ‘DO YOU 
WANT SOME TOYS?’ JOHN ANSWERS: ‘YES’. JOHN CLEANS HIS NOSE WITH HIS FINGER. 
THE ACTRESS GIVES A TOY DOG AND A BALL TO JOHN. JOHN TAKES THE TOYS AND 
SAYS: ‘THANK YOU’. THE ACTRESS STANDS UP. SHE GIVES THE BABY BACK TO ITS 
MOTHER. THEN, SHE GIVES THE WOMAN SOME MONEY . THE WOMAN SAYS: ‘THANK 
YOU’. SHE LEA VES. THE ACTRESS IS VERY SAD. SHE GOES BACK HOME. JOHN WATCHES  
HER LEA VE. HE WA VES GOODBYE.

IT IS MORNING. JOHN IS MAKING BREAKFAST. CHARLIE IS LYING IN BED. HE IS 
READING. JOHN IS FRYING PANCAKES IN A FRYING PAN. HE WAITS. HE TASTES THE 
PANCAKE. JOHN SAYS: ‘IT IS DELICIOUS.’ CHARLIE IS SMOKING AND READING A 
NEWSPAPER. JOHN PUTS THE PANCAKES ON THE TABLE. HE GETS A KNIFE AND A FORK.  
HE CALLS CHARLIE TO EAT BREAKFAST. CHARLIE DOESN’T COME. JOHN GOES TO 
CHARLIE. JOHN TAKES HIS NEWSPAPER. JOHN SAYS: ‘COME AND EAT BREAKFAST 
NOW’. CHARLIE SCRATCHES HIS ARM. HE YAWNS AND HE STRETCHES. HIS FOOT GOES 
THROUGH A HOLE IN HIS COVER. THEN CHARLIE PUTS HIS HEAD THROUGH THE HOLE 
IN THE COVER. HE STANDS UP. NOW THE COVER IS CHARLIE’S COAT.  CHARLIE’S 
SHOES ARE VERY OLD. CHARLIE PUTS ON HIS SHOES.

CHARLIE GETS A CHAIR. HE SITS DOWN AT THE TABLE. HE GIVES HALF OF THE 
PANCAKES TO JOHN. HE PUTS THE OTHER HALF ON HIS PLATE. NOW HE COUNTS THE 
PANCAKES. HE HAS ONE MORE PANCAKE THAN JOHN. HE CUTS THE PANCAKE IN TWO. 
HE PUTS ONE HALF ON JOHN’S PLATE. HE PUTS THE OTHER HALF ON HIS PLATE. THEY 
PICK UP THEIR FORKS AND KNIVES. BUT CHARLIES SAYS: ‘NO, WE PRAY BEFORE WE 
EAT’. THEY PRAY . THEN JOHN PUTS SYRUP ON HIS PLATE. CHARLIE PUTS BUTTER ON 
HIS PANCAKES. THEN CHARLIE SAYS: ‘GIVE ME THE SYRUP.’ JOHN GIVES HIM THE 
SYRUP. CHARLIE PUTS SYRUP ON HIS PANCAKE.

THEY EAT ALL THE PANCAKES. JOHN IS HITTING HIS PLATE WITH HIS KNIFE AND 
FORK. CHARLIE BELCHES. JOHN ASKS: ‘CAN I GO OUT AND PLAY WITH MY TOYS?’ 
CHARLIE ANSWERS: ‘YES, YOU CAN’. JOHN GETS HIS HAT AND HIS TOYS. HE KISSES HIS  
TOY DOG. THEN, HE ASKS CHARLIE TO KISS THE DOG. CHARLIE BELCHES AGAIN. JOHN 
GOES OUT. HE SITS DOWN ON THE DOORSTEP. A BIG BOY COMES. HE STOPS AT THE 
CORNER. HE IS BIGGER THAN JOHN. HE SCRATCHES HIS HEAD. HE SEES JOHN PLAYING 
WITH THE TOYS. HE WANTS THE TOYS. HE TAKES JOHN’S TOYS.  HE RUNS AWAY . JOHN 
RUNS AFTER HIM. THE BIG BOY THROWS THE TOYS OVER THE WALL. HE STOPS AND 
TURNS AROUND. JOHN AND THE BIG BOY START TO FIGHT. A LOT OF PEOPLE COME. 
THEY WANT TO WATCH THE FIGHT. A FAT MAN WITH A BEARD LIKES THE FIGHT. HE 
SMILES AND CLAPS.

CHARLIE COMES OUT OF HIS HOUSE. HE HEARS THE BOYS FIGHTING. HE TURNS 
AROUND AND SEES THEM. HE RUNS TO JOHN. HE WANTS TO STOP THE FIGHT. THE TWO  
BOYS ARE ON THE GROUND, FIGHTING. CHARLIE PICKS UP JOHN BY THE PANTS. THE 
MAN WITH THE MUSTACHE SAYS: ‘I WANT TO SEE THE BOYS FIGHT.’ CHARLIE PUTS 
DOWN JOHN. JOHN GOES TO FIGHT THE BIG BOY . JOHN HITS THE BIG BOY . THE BIG 
BOY FALLS DOWN. NOW, CHARLIE LIKES THE FIGHT. CHARLIE SAYS: ‘WAIT. REST FIVE 
MINUTES.’ CHARLIE SITS JOHN IN THE WINDOW. HE DRINKS SOME WATER. CHARLIE 
SPITS THE WATER IN THE FAT MAN’S FACE. CHARLIE SAYS: ‘HIT THE BIG BOY ON THE 
NOSE. THEN, HIT HIM IN THE STOMACH. THEN, KICK HIM THE BEHIND.’

THE BIG BOY IS CRYING. HIS BIG BROTHER COMES. HE IS STRONG. HE IS A BAD 
MAN. HE PUSHES TWO MEN. HE HITS THE MAN TALKING TO HIS LITTLE BROTHER. HE 
ASKS HIS BROTHER: ‘WHO HIT YOU?’ THE BOY POINTS AND SAYS: ‘THAT BOY SITTING 
IN THE WINDOW HIT ME.’ THE BIG BROTHER GOES TO TALK TO CHARLIE. CHARLIE 
SEES THE BIG BROTHER. HE IS AFRAID. CHARLIE SAYS TO JOHN: ‘YOU ARE A BAD BOY . 
GO HOME.’ CHARLIE STARTS TO LEA VE. BUT THE BIG BROTHER PUTS HIS HAND ON 
CHARLIE’S SHOULDER. HE PULLS CHARLIE BACK. HE SAYS: ‘YOU STAY HERE. MY 
BROTHER AND YOUR BOY ARE GOING TO FIGHT.’ THE BIG BROTHER SAYS: ‘IF YOUR 
BOY BEATS MY BROTHER, THEN, I’M GOING TO BEAT YOU’. NOW CHARLIE IS WORRIED.  
HE DOESN’T WANT JOHN TO BEAT THE BOY . BUT JOHN IS BEATING HIM. JOHN FALLS 
DOWN. CHARLIE PUTS HIS FOOT ON HIS STOMACH. HE SAYS: ‘ YOUR BROTHER BEAT 
MY BOY . CONGRATULATIONS’. CHARLIE SHAKES THE BIG BROTHER’S HAND.

JOHN HITS THE BOY AGAIN. NOW, THE BIG BROTHER WANTS TO HIT CHARLIE. 
CHARLIE SAYS: ‘I DON’T WANT TO FIGHT’. THE POLICEMAN COMES TO STOP THE FIGHT. 
THE BIG BROTHER HITS THE POLICEMAN. THE POLICEMAN FALLS DOWN. HE TRIES TO 
HIT CHARLIE. BUT CHARLIE IS VERY FAST. THE BIG BROTHER CAN’T HIT HIM. HE TRIES  
AGAIN AND AGAIN.  BUT, HE CAN’T HIT CHARLIE. HE TRIES AGAIN. BUT, HE HITS THE 
WALL AND BREAKS IT. HE TRIES AGAIN. BUT, HE HITS THE POST. CHARLIE JUMPS 
THROUGH THE WINDOW. THE BIG BROTHER LOOKS FOR HIM. HE PULLS CHARLIE 
THROUGH THE WINDOW. HE IS GOING TO HIT CHARLIE. BUT, THE ACTRESS STOPS HIM. 
HE LIKES THE ACTRESS. THE BIG BROTHER DOESN’T HIT CHARLIE.

THE ACTRESS SAYS TO CHARLIE: ‘PLEASE DON'T HIT THIS MAN’. CHARLIE SAYS: 
‘NO, I DON’T WANT TO HIT HIM’. THE ACTRESS SAYS: ‘PLEASE SHAKE HANDS’. THE BIG 
BROTHER DOESN’T WANT TO SHAKE HANDS. THE ACTRESS ASKS HIM AGAIN. THE BIG 
BROTHER SHAKES CHARLIE’S HAND. CHARLIE FINDS A BRICK. HE WANTS TO HIT THE 
BIG BROTHER WITH THE BRICK. HE IS AFRAID OF THE BIG BROTHER. HE PUTS DOWN 
THE BRICK. THE ACTRESS SAYS: ‘IF HE HITS YOU ON ONE CHEEK, OFFER HIM THE 
OTHER’. THE BIG BROTHER SAYS TO CHARLIE: ‘HIT ME HERE’. CHARLIE HITS HIM. THE 
BIG BROTHER IS ANGRY . HE WANTS TO HIT CHARLIE. BUT, THE ACTRESS STOPS HIM. 
CHARLIE HITS THE BIG BROTHER ON THE HEAD WITH A BRICK. HE KICKS HIM IN THE 
BEHIND. HE HITS HIM ON THE HEAD AGAIN. HE KICKS HIM AGAIN. CHARLIE POINTS AT 
THE GROUND. THE BIG BROTHER LOOKS DOWN. CHARLIE HITS HIM ON THE HAD WITH  
A BRICK AGAIN.
